name: Savri
description: Savri is a privacy-first web analytics platform - GDPR-compliant by default, no cookies, no IP storage, no PII. The Claude Connector exposes 15 tools to read your traffic data (visitors, pageviews, top pages, referrers, countries, goals, funnels) and to create or delete conversion goals and funnels directly from chat. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 with PKCE - no API keys to copy. Claude only accesses the sites you already have access to in Savri, with read and write scopes granted separately at consent time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Savri to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Savri to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://savri.io/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Savri MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Savri lists 15 MCP tools, including savri_list_sites, savri_get_stats, savri_get_pages, savri_get_referrers, savri_get_countries, savri_list_properties, savri_create_property, savri_delete_property, savri_list_goals, savri_create_goal, savri_delete_goal, and savri_list_funnels.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Savri?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Savri in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Savri requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Savri is developed by Digisol AB. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
